build_system.note: ONLYOFFICE builds with qmake (137 .pro files). Only desktop-sdk uses CMake (27 of the 32 CMakeLists.txt in the tree).

theme_path.description: Editor colour themes. theme_lightwps.json is installed here and registered in themes.json.

theme_file.description: The LightOffice theme itself (90 colour keys, matching upstream's full-theme reference set).

theme_registry.description: Theme manifest the editors read to populate the appearance menu.

theme_variables_less.description: Defines the :root CSS custom properties the theme JSON overrides.

theme_canvas_consumer.description: Canvas renderer; reads the canvas-* theme keys that never appear in LESS.

menu_config_path.description: Builds the document editor toolbar and adds the collaboration tab. LightOffice forces that tab off here.

menu_layout_manager.description: Upstream's supported element-visibility gate (customization.layout), licence-gated behind canBrandingExt.

plugin_host.description: Plugin loader. Disabled by the overlay, which is what removes the AI assistant (upstream ships it as a plugin, not built-in UI).

cloud_provider_registry.description: Per-provider config.json + icons for every cloud the desktop client can connect to. The lightoffice/ provider is added here.

cloud_provider_addon_registry.description: Secondary registry of external cloud providers.

cloud_connect_dialog.description: The connect-to-cloud dialog; reads the portal URL the user enters.

branding_vendor_hook.description: Vendor override hook included at the end of version.h. LightOffice branding is injected here, leaving upstream sources untouched.

build_defaults_pri.description: qmake defaults for the desktop app; the size-optimisation profile is included from here.

desktop_project_file.description: Top-level qmake project for the desktop application.

dictionaries_path.description: Hunspell dictionaries. Trimmed to the shipped locale set.

menu_config_all_editors.description: Every editor's toolbar controller — all four gain the collaboration trim.
